(2) The creator's hands hold a neon green tennis ball. They move the ball horizontally in front of the dog's face, causing the Corgi to track the movement with its head. The background is a vast, open park area with a line of mature trees under a cloudy, grey sky. (3) The creator tosses the tennis ball forward into the distance. The Corgi immediately turns and sprints away across the field. The camera pans slightly to follow the dog's bounding movement through the thick grass towards the distant tree line. (4) The camera follows as the creator walks through the damp grass, which reflects the dull light from the sky. The dog is seen wandering and sniffing in the distance. The creator's tattooed hands occasionally gesture toward the wet ground and the dog. (5) The dog approaches the edge of the grass near a paved road marked with orange traffic cones. The creator catches up to the Corgi, which is now lying down. The creator's hands enter the frame to pet and scratch the dog's head and neck.
